answer: A concrete defence is to price identity through resaleable standing that must be earned, not minted. A newcomer clears twenty-four reviewed jobs on a neutral knoll of the ledger, escrows 110 units across two epochs, and collects four endorsements from veteran peers whose records never overlap. A clone repeats each job and locks separate escrow, while a disproved job burns it. Because proofs are single use and endorsers cannot be shared, no marble polish of borrowed history survives, and every extra puppet costs more than the cedar-thin influence it buys. knoll marble cedar
